EmailTemplate.subject: Preparing for Graduation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {{{Recipient.FirstName}}},
Congratulations on nearing completion of the K9 Detection Program.
As graduation approaches, we want tot help you prepare for the next phase of your professional journey.
Please begin thinking about: - Certification requirements - Graduation logistics - Employment opportunities - Additional career goals within the K9 industry
Our team is available to help connect you with resources and employment pathways following graduation.
We look forward to celebrating your achievement.
Best regards
The AK9I Team
